name: whisper-meetings
description: Record meetings on your Mac, transcribe with local Whisper, and analyze or hand off the results.

interface.longDescription: Record and pause meeting audio on your Mac. Read provisional local Whisper text during recording, then get final transcripts, speaker estimates and concise reports after stopping.
defaultPrompt: Record this meeting with local Whisper transcription
Analyze my last meeting and link it to a calendar event

publication.release_notes: 0.5.0 prerelease: pause/resume with native acknowledgements and compressed audio timelines; provisional local Whisper text from finalized ~12-second chunks; independent live/final transcription controls. Native writer and offline Russian live-worker checks passed; live calls and production host remain unverified. Rebuild the recorder with setup.py --skip-model when upgrading.
